Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <4a5o7n$b...@hustle.rahul.net>,
Bradley Kellogg <br...@rahul.net> wrote:
>I have a friend wjo plays Gangerals with a ton of Backways and he always
>has one in play. The real problem is that if you block his bleed or
>action, you go to torpor. He waits until the strikes have been declared
>and then plays wolf claws if you don't manuever or dodge after the stike
>has happend. I say that this is illegal because it says for the remainer
>of the turn and I think it must be played before strikes. Who is right?
>Thanks
>

He is. Claws are best played after strikes are announce, but before
damage resolution (aka strike resolution). After you've announced
your strike, you can't change your mind when he modifies his hand strike
to do aggravated damage. Sorry. Best to always maneuver to long
or to dodge (or S:CE).

strike. Of course, we play with a limit on S:CE cards too... :-)

Messages.Body:

has one in play. The real problem is that if you block his bleed or
action, you go to torpor. He waits until the strikes have been declared
and then plays wolf claws if you don't manuever or dodge after the stike
has happend. I say that this is illegal because it says for the remainer
of the turn and I think it must be played before strikes. Who is right?
